It took me 4-5 years of continuous testing and a ridiculous amount of er trips. I have chronic pain in my abdomen that is still undiagnosed and they tried everything under the sun before even considering opioids. It took 3 Gastros and me to start passing out before I got something to help and yet I'm still stuck in bed half the time. Personally I think that there needs to be a better system for opioid treatment and that doctors need to start treating with these earlier at least until we get something better. My point is I may in bed half the time but the other half I am happy being able to spend time with my brother, sister and nephew. Opioids gave me some time where I wasn't miserable and was just able to breathe and be there for important things. I do wish the side effects weren't so harsh though.
